title: 17, 13, 9, 5, …: nth term 21 − 4n
caption: The terms fall by 4 each time, so the nth term is −4n + c; n = 1 gives c = 21. The rule 21 − 4n gives every term, and the 30th is 21 − 120 = −99.
alt: Four boxes 17, 13, 9, 5 with arrows of −4 between them, and the rule nth term = 21 − 4n.
description: The terms are 17, 13, 9 and 5, for n = 1 to 4.
Each step is −4: the common difference.
The nth term is 21 − 4n; for n = 30 it is −99.
